items.title: Lilly TuneLab pharma-powered AI models now in Benchling
items.summary: Benchling users can now run predictive AI models trained on decades of Eli Lilly's proprietary research data — flagging antibody developability issues and small molecule small molecule property prediction signals before a single assay is run.

items.title: Can LLMs work in the wet lab?
items.summary: Benchling published BenchBench-Protocol, a benchmark testing if LLMs can troubleshoot wet lab protocols like expert scientists. Top models still miss the practical judgment lab work requires, showing a real gap between knowing biology and doing it.

items.title: Women in Sales at Benchling
items.summary: What does it take to build a career in tech sales at a biotech software company? Six women at Benchling share their paths, and the advice they'd give anyone coming up behind them.

items.title: Vibe coding enters the lab
items.summary: Benchling launches vibe coding: scientists can now prompt AI to build shareable, reproducible R&D applications like candidate dashboards and program trackers.

items.title: Scientific models: free, fast, and for everyone
items.summary: Open source models don't mean easy access — getting them running still requires GPUs, infrastructure, and significant technical overhead. Today, Benchling.ai lets any scientist run the latest structure prediction models in under a minute, for free.

items.title: Three ways AI is delivering value for in vivo research teams
items.summary: In vivo teams are moving past curiosity about AI. Here's where it's delivering real, day-to-day value — from ingesting CRO data packages to catching anomalies before they compound.

items.title: Polish Bash 2026: Turning customer feedback into shipped fixes
items.summary: Every year, Benchling Engineering sets aside the roadmap for a week to ship the fixes scientists ask for most. This year: 541 ideas in, 114 shipped in five days, with AI agents as active collaborators for the first time.

items.title: Structure prediction has been around for years. Why isn’t everyone using it?
items.summary: Benchling AI agents now call directly into our Model Hub, allowing any scientist to run and analyze complex predictions with just a prompt.

items.title: How Benchling's new Chief Information Security Officer is thinking about security in the age of AI agents
items.summary: Meet Chad Kalmes, who joined Benchling as CISO and CIO this year. This conversation covers what breaks in security models when AI agents replace humans as the primary actors, why the research data layer is contested real estate in science, and more.

items.title: AI read 200 million papers, but still missed your last experiment
items.summary: A hypothesis built from public data alone is a consensus hypothesis. Benchling AI's new Hypothesis Generation combines your institutional data with the published literature — so the starting point is your science, not everyone else's.

items.title: The ELN is dead, long live the ELN
items.summary: From raw ELISA data to a complete notebook entry with analysis and recommendations — all without leaving the experiment. Here's what the new Benchling AI, rebuilt inside the notebook, can do.

items.title: Benchling Automation: Closing the lab-in-a-loop
items.summary: Setting up lab automation has historically meant hardware engineering, bespoke integrations, and rebuilds every time a workflow changes. Benchling Automation is built to change that — connecting instruments, analyses, and scientific records in one system.

items.title: Behind the Model: Building A World Model for Protein Biology with Sal Candido of Biohub
items.summary: What does it mean to build a world model for protein biology? Biohub's Sal Candido joins Benchling's Mihir Trivedi to unpack the ESM ecosystem — from ESMFold2's speed advantages to what the Atlas reveals across 6.8 billion proteins.

items.title: Announcing Benchling Inference powered by Baseten: Scalable GPUs for scientific AI
items.summary: Scientific model workloads are too bursty for traditional infrastructure. Benchling Inference gives biopharma teams scalable, cost-effective GPU capacity to run and train scientific models without managing the infrastructure behind them.

items.title: Introducing Benchling Model Hub: The infrastructure layer for scientific AI
items.summary: Benchling Model Hub is now available — a dedicated home for scientific AI models inside Benchling, with batch predictions, job tracking, and structured outputs connected directly to your experimental record.

items.title: What a difference a year makes: The evolution of the AI conversation
items.summary: At a recent Benchling user group, on attendee called the SQL Writer "brilliant" after building dashboards she’d have struggled to create manually. Here's how one user group moved from stuck on approvals to pushing on limits in a year.

items.title: Benchling Biologics delivers no-code antibody format design and automated registration at scale
items.summary: Benchling Biologics is now the end-to-end platform for antibody R&D — giving teams a no-code way to configure any antibody format, register proteins at scale, and build the AI-ready data foundation modern drug discovery requires.

items.title: How Prime Medicine scientists used Benchling’s AI Scientist to accelerate PM359’s path to BLA
items.summary: Benchling's collaboration with Prime Medicine shows what an AI Scientist brings to one of the hardest phases of taking an advanced modality to market: the final CMC push toward a BLA.

items.title: Direct ordering for experiments and data with Twist Bioscience, Adaptyv, and Ginkgo Bioworks
items.summary: The gap between design and experimental validation just got smaller. Scientists can now design candidates, place orders with synthesis and assay partners, and get structured results all within Benchling.

items.title: An AI Scientist that deserves the name
items.summary: The AI Scientist wires together the digital and physical worlds of R&D. Predictive models, data infrastructure, and wet lab execution all feed a single compounding loop: design an experiment, run it, and learn.

items.title: Benchling Launches AI Connectors to Power the Data Ecosystem for R&D
items.summary: Benchling launches AI Connectors, pre-built MCP integrations that link scientific and enterprise tools directly to R&D workflows — so every AI tool can build on the full context of experimental work.

items.title: How Beam Therapeutics cut report writing from many days to under 3 hours with Benchling AI
items.summary: At Beam Therapeutics, producing regulatory reports meant hours of manual data prep before the writing even started. Benchling's Deep Research Agent cut that timeline from days to under 3 hours — here's how they did it.

items.title: The science behind one family’s hope: A patient story from Seattle Children's Hospital
items.summary: When Mallory Carlson's twin daughters were diagnosed with infant leukemia, weeks of waiting stood between them and treatment. Here's how Dr. Jay Sarthy at Seattle Children's is using Benchling to compress that timeline from months to a single day.

items.title: Benchling and HighRes: Lab automation just got easier
items.summary: Setting up a plate-based assay shouldn't take half a day. A new integration between Benchling and HighRes connects experiment design, robotic execution, and analyzed results in a single automated workflow.

items.title: The difference between purpose-built R&D agents and enterprise AI assistants
items.summary: Connecting your enterprise AI to your lab software via MCP is a good start. But accessing your data and understanding it aren't the same thing. Here's how AI agents purpose-built for science fill that gap.

items.title: Leading with intent: 5 lessons from women reshaping biotech
items.summary: Relationships as a superpower and documentation as a form of resistance. Senior leaders from Sanofi, Ottimo Pharma, and beyond get honest about the principles that have shaped their careers — and why you don't need a title to start applying them.

items.title: 4 ways scientists are automating lab documentation with AI
items.summary: Tired of manually typing up protocols and experiment notes? Here are 4 AI workflows to automate lab documentation — turning everything from messy whiteboard notes to CRO data into structured entries.

items.title: Reinventing non-clinical reporting at Enveda with Benchling’s Deep Research Agent
items.summary: What if scientists could draft reports in a day instead of weeks? Learn how Enveda's scientists are reinventing their non-clinical reporting process and compressing timelines by 400% with Deep Research.

items.title: Are we missing the boat? Moderna and IFF on the reality of AI readiness
items.summary: Moderna's Al Park and IFF's Casper Vroemen get candid about unifying 12 R&D facilities, migrating years of structured data, building scientist adoption from the ground up — and why waiting for the perfect plan means missing the boat.

items.title: 500 biotech companies are using Benchling AI, now generally available
items.summary: Benchling AI is now generally available. From Beam Therapeutics to Mammoth Biosciences, hundreds of teams are using it to automate busywork and unlock buried data — so they can focus on the experiments and decisions that matter.

items.title: 3 AI truths from the 3rd Paris Digital Science & Innovation Day
items.summary: What separates AI pilots that fail from those that scale? Leaders from Owkin, One Biosciences, Phagos, and other European biotechs share practical lessons from real AI deployments.

items.title: 5 data governance moves every biotech startup should make in the age of AI
items.summary: Data governance doesn't have to slow you down. Five practical strategies to help biotech startups scale R&D with AI-ready data.

items.title: Standardizing antibody therapeutic nomenclature: Why it matters
items.summary: Bispecifics, multispecifics, ADCs — antibody therapeutic formats are proliferating faster than the field can name them consistently. Here's why standardized antibody nomenclature matters, and what AbML and VERITAS are doing about it.

items.title: Benchling and Lilly TuneLab Partner to Democratize Access to AI Models for Scientists Everywhere
items.summary: Benchling partners with Lilly TuneLab to give 1,300+ biotech companies access to AI models trained on $1B+ of Lilly research data — directly in scientists' workflows.

items.title: Biotech has a developer problem — here’s how to fix it
items.summary: AI didn't create biotech's data infrastructure problems, but it did make them impossible to ignore. The path forward? Platforms where developers and scientists can finally build together. Here's how.

items.title: 12 days of Benchling is back for the holidays!
items.summary: The 12 days of Benchling are back — and Jeffy P is ready with more science, surprises, and a festive giveaway you won’t want to miss.

items.title: Meet the 2025 Benchtalk Boston Changemakers
items.summary: Meet the people behind this year’s Benchling Changemaker Awards and the real stories of how they’re improving the day-to-day scientific work to drive big breakthroughs.

items.title: How Europe’s R&D leaders are transforming biotech with Benchling
items.summary: From precision cells to sustainable food, meet the scientists driving breakthroughs in R&D across Europe with Benchling.

items.title: Here’s everything we released at Benchtalk 2025
items.summary: Explore the future of biotech unveiled at Benchtalk 2025. Discover how Benchling is rebuilding R&D for the AI era with new scientific AI agents and models, breakthroughs in antibody discovery, powerful automation tools and expanded development features.

items.title: Behind the Model: Building BoltzGen with Hannes Stärk
items.summary: Go "Behind the Model" with BoltzGen co-creator Hannes Stärk. Learn how Benchling and MIT built and validated BoltzGen for generative protein design, ensuring transparency and rigor in scientific AI.

items.title: Benchling Partners with Anthropic to Build a Bridge Between Science and AI
items.summary: Benchling partners with Anthropic to bring its data foundation and AI agents to Claude. Scientists can now securely query R&D data to get clear, source-linked answers, summaries, and decision-ready reports in minutes.

items.title: AI tools for the modern lab
items.summary: The future of scientific work is here with Benchling AI. We’re excited to introduce two exciting additions to Benchling: AI Agents and Models — powerful ways to accelerate workflows, automate toil, and unlock insights from your data.

items.title: Benchling Reveals the Next Chapter of R&D at Benchtalk 2025
items.summary: Benchling unveiled Benchling AI and major R&D updates at Benchtalk 2025. Discover new capabilities for antibody discovery, automation, and development—all integrated to accelerate scientific progress.

items.title: Benchling for development in the era of automation and efficiency
items.summary: Process Development is evolving fast. See how Benchling is helping scientists automate data capture, standardize recipes, and run more flexible studies — from early experiments to GMP-ready workflows — all on one connected platform.

items.title: End-to-end automated workflows for AI-first R&D
items.summary: Discover Benchling Connect and Insights. Benchling lets scientists automate, visualize, and optimize experiments, turning complex R&D data into faster discoveries.

items.title: Introducing Benchling Biologics: An end-to-end solution for AI-powered antibody discovery
items.summary: Antibody discovery is evolving — and so is Benchling. Explore Benchling Biologics, an integrated solution that connects wet and dry labs with AI-ready data, accelerating discovery from sequence to study.

items.title: How Benchling is reimagining the ELN for connected, AI-native science
items.summary: The ELN changed how we document science. AI will change how we do it. Explore how Benchling is reimagining the ELN for the AI-first lab.

items.title: Benchling Powers AI Model Access for Scientists With NVIDIA
items.summary: Benchling integrates NVIDIA NIM microservices to power Benchling AI, giving scientists direct access to GPU-optimized models like OpenFold2 for faster, reliable protein structure prediction and accelerated discovery.

items.title: AI for every scientist
items.summary: Benchling co-founder Ashu Singhal shares a vision to put AI in the hands of every scientist — starting with making it accessible to academia.

items.title: Introducing Benchling AI
items.summary: Benchling AI is available today, bringing agents and predictive models directly into scientific workflows. Accelerate discovery by automating toil and unlocking insights from structured data.
